summary: OpenAI released version 1.0.5 of its codex-plugin-cc, adding a /codex:transfer command for handing off sessions to Claude Code.

practices.reason: A new slash command for session handoff between Codex and Claude Code is a minor interface addition that teams using this plugin might adopt but which creates no broader integration work.
